floor_commit_note: host-side spike; no Android SDK device execution

iterations.hypothesis: Quiet notification/companion affordance can remain available while browser is foregrounded without SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.
Reopening EscapeHatch restores the identical assist session identity and origin binding.
At least one supported Android handoff (deep link and Sharesheet text) can carry application context into EscapeHatch.
Dismiss preserves session and ordinary browser navigation does not spawn repeated prompts.
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW is unnecessary for V1 because a lower-authority mechanism scores higher on quiet presence + policy + onboarding.
Android Bubbles are unsuitable as V1 primary because API 30+ conversation requirements fight presence-not-nag doctrine for job assist.
iterations.observation: recommendation=optional_enhancement_after_v1; doctrine_fit=medium — floating affordance ok only if quiet and user-opted

mechanism_matrix_embedded.play_policy: allowed via notification API; conversation semantics required for reliable bubbling on API 30+

mechanism_matrix_embedded.security: system-managed bubble; lower spoof risk than TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
mechanism_matrix_embedded.doctrine_fit: medium — floating affordance ok only if quiet and user-opted
